title: Approval of the First Amendment to Contract DA-5695 with International Coatings Company Inc.: To increase the contract authority by $700,000, for new total not to exceed $1,600,000, and extend the ter
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 9]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the First Amendment to Contract DA-5695 with International Coatings Company Inc.: To increase the contract authority by $700,000, for new total not to exceed $1,600,000, and extend the term by two (2) years, for new expiration date of February 5, 2029, covering supply and delivery of airfield and traffic marking paint for Los Angeles International Airport and Van Nuys Airport (Daniel Hughes)
summary: Adds $700,000 to a contract with International Coatings Company for airfield and traffic marking paint at LAX and Van Nuys Airport, raising the total to $1,600,000 and extending it to February 5, 2029.
